# Mise Culinary Intelligence Engine — Full LLM Specification & Knowledge Base

## Overview
Mise is a state-of-the-art intelligent culinary web platform designed to eliminate food waste and elevate home cooking through real-time AI pantry vision, semantic ingredient matching, dynamic recipe adaptation, and guided step-by-step cooking.

## System Architecture

```
Client (Next.js 14 PWA)
 ├── Multi-Modal Camera & Photo Capture
 ├── Framer Motion Glassmorphic UI
 ├── Web Audio Haptic & Timer Controls
 └── LocalStorage & Supabase Real-Time State Sync
      │
      ├── /api/detect-ingredients (Vision API)
      ├── /api/match-recipes (Deterministic & Semantic Matching Engine)
      ├── /api/adapt-recipe (Dynamic Recipe Customizer)
      └── /api/chat (Conversational LLM Sous-Chef)
```

## Recipe Database & Nutritional Schemas

### 1. Garlic Pasta Aglio e Olio (ID: `pasta-001`)
- **Diet**: Vegetarian / Vegan-adaptable
- **Prep & Cook Time**: 15 minutes
- **Difficulty**: Easy
- **Confidence Baseline**: 100% with standard pantry staples
- **Core Ingredients**: Spaghetti/Fusilli, Fresh Garlic, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Red Pepper Flakes, Fresh Parsley, Salt.
- **Macronutrients**: Carbs 52g, Fats 14g, Protein 9g, Calories 380 kcal.
- **Flavor Profile**: Pungent, savory, lightly spiced, aromatic.

### 2. Golden Turmeric Chickpea Curry (ID: `curry-002`)
- **Diet**: Vegan, Gluten-Free
- **Prep & Cook Time**: 20 minutes
- **Difficulty**: Quick
- **Confidence Baseline**: 95%
- **Core Ingredients**: Cooked Chickpeas, Coconut Milk, Ground Turmeric, Cumin, Diced Onion, Garlic, Fresh Ginger, Spinach.
- **Macronutrients**: Carbs 44g, Fats 12g, Protein 14g, Calories 340 kcal.
- **Flavor Profile**: Earthy, warming, creamy, comforting.

### 3. Mediterranean Quinoa Harvest Bowl (ID: `bowl-001`)
- **Diet**: Vegetarian, Gluten-Free
- **Prep & Cook Time**: 25 minutes
- **Difficulty**: Easy
- **Confidence Baseline**: 90%
- **Core Ingredients**: Cooked Quinoa, Avocado, Cherry Tomatoes, English Cucumber, Kalamata Olives, Baby Spinach, Lemon Tahini Dressing.

- **Flavor Profile**: Smoky, tangy, savory, rich.

## Ingredient Substitution Matrix

Mise incorporates an intelligent culinary fallback hierarchy:
- **Alliums**: Shallots <-> Yellow Onion <-> Scallions / Green Onions <-> Leeks
- **Acids**: Lemon Juice <-> Lime Juice <-> White Wine Vinegar <-> Apple Cider Vinegar
- **Fats & Oils**: Extra Virgin Olive Oil <-> Avocado Oil <-> Butter <-> Ghee <-> Neutral Canola Oil
- **Aromatics**: Fresh Garlic <-> Garlic Powder (1/4 tsp per clove) <-> Asafoetida / Hing (Jain alternative)
- **Dairy & Creaminess**: Heavy Cream <-> Coconut Cream <-> Greek Yogurt <-> Cashew Paste
- **Proteins**: Chicken Breast <-> Firm Tofu <-> Paneer <-> Canned Chickpeas / Lentils

## Dietary Filter Enforcements

1. **Vegetarian (`veg`)**: Excludes all poultry, red meat, fish, gelatin, and meat-based stocks. Allows dairy and honey.
2. **Vegan (`vegan`)**: Excludes all animal products, dairy, eggs, honey, and gelatin.
3. **Jain (`jain`)**: Excludes root vegetables (garlic, onion, potato, carrots, radish) and all meat/poultry/fish/eggs. Allows dairy and above-ground grains and vegetables.
4. **Allergies Supported**: Peanuts, Tree Nuts, Dairy/Lactose, Gluten, Shellfish, Soy, Sesame, Eggs.
